Doubling Down: Mark Roberge, Co-Founder and Managing Director at Stage 2 Capital
“Double down on AI.” That’s the advice coming from Mark Roberge, co-founder and managing director at Stage 2 Capital. As someone who’s been investing in B2B software since 2010—and was formerly the SVP of Sales & Success at HubSpot—he knows where the puck is going. And right now? It’s accelerating faster than ever before. “We’ve never seen anything like this,” he explains. “It started with ChatGPT exploding into the consumer space, then LLMs became the new infrastructure layer, and now we’re seeing the explosion into vertical solutions.”
The speed has been breathtaking. Companies are reaching $100M ARR in under 18 months—not years—thanks to advancements in GenAI models and API-first architecture. But here’s the thing: This isn’t just another technology wave. It represents a fundamental shift in how B2B applications get built, deployed, and scaled. Why Every B2B Company Needs to Go Vertical (And How to Actually Do It)
Roberge emphasizes that this isn’t about adding “a little bit” of AI to existing workflows—it’s about fundamentally rethinking how work gets done through agentic systems powered by Generative AI Models. Think about it: When employees were working manually, every task required multiple steps. You’d look up information, draft documents, send emails, wait for responses…rinse and repeat throughout the day. Now imagine if those same tasks could complete themselves autonomously. That’s exactly what’s happening with vertical-specific platforms.
